name: perimeter_chain_01
notes: Synchronized CAVIAR EnterExitCrossingPaths1 views with camera-specific polygons representing one physical shop boundary. The existing point-in-polygon intrusion rule follows the virtual-fence framing of Kim, Lim and Kim, Intelligent intrusion detection system featuring a virtual fence, Annals of Nuclear Energy 112 (2018), doi:10.1016/j.anucene.2017.11.026. Dataset: EC-funded CAVIAR project IST 2001 37540, CC BY-SA.
